examFormat.zh: 期中考试 11 月 2 日（周一）下午 3:15 准时开考，90 分钟，占 25%；期末考试 3 小时，覆盖全部内容，占 50%。去年的期中是 25 道单选题（每题 5 个选项，涂 Scantron 答题卡）。期中可带一张双面的 aid sheet（letter 纸，手写或打印都行），期末可带两张；考试会提供需要的统计表；只能用不可编程、不能联网的科学计算器（例如 TI-30Xa、Casio fx-300MS Plus）。考试时禁止使用生成式 AI。
examFormat.en: Midterm test on Monday Nov 2 (starts exactly at 3:15 PM, 90 minutes, 25%) and a 3-hour final exam on all material (50%). Last year's midterm was 25 multiple-choice questions (5 options each, Scantron). Bring one double-sided letter-size aid sheet (handwritten or typed) to the midterm and two to the final; statistical tables are provided; only a non-programmable scientific calculator (e.g. TI-30Xa, Casio fx-300MS Plus). No generative AI during tests.

note.zh: 按去年期中的样子组卷：25 道单选题（每题 5 个选项），90 分钟；算出来的数不在选项里，就选最接近的那个。
note.en: Built like last year's midterm: 25 multiple-choice questions (5 options each) in 90 minutes; if your exact number is not listed, choose the closest option.

detail.zh: 12 次讲课里至少完成 10 次课堂小活动即可拿满 2%；只看是否参与，不看对错。
detail.en: Complete the in-lecture activity in at least 10 of the 12 lectures for the full 2%; marked on completion, not accuracy.

detail.zh: 共 11 次辅导课，取最高的 8 次；只看参与。课前要复习讲课内容、做练习题和 mini-R 活动。
detail.en: 11 tutorials, best 8 count; marked on completion. Before each tutorial, review the lecture, work on the practice problems and do the mini-R activity.

detail.zh: 11 月 2 日周一，下午 3:15 准时开考，90 分钟，现场考试，迟到不补时间。可带一张双面 aid sheet；提供统计表；带批准的计算器。考试范围老师会至少提前一周在 Quercus 公布，以老师公布为准。
detail.en: Monday Nov 2, starts exactly at 3:15 PM, 90 minutes, in person; no extra time for late arrivals. One double-sided aid sheet, statistical tables provided, approved calculator. The coverage is posted on Quercus at least one week before the test.

detail.zh: 两人或 3–5 人小组，用课程里分析过的数据集做一张信息图，12 月 2 日前在 Quercus 提交。
detail.en: In pairs or groups of 3-5, make an infographic from a dataset analysed in the course; submit on Quercus by Dec 2.

detail.zh: 匿名课程问卷，12 月 8 日晚上 11 点前在 Quercus 完成。
detail.en: Anonymous survey on Quercus, due Dec 8 at 11:00 PM.

detail.zh: 12 月考试周进行，具体日期以教务处公布为准。3 小时，覆盖全部内容；可带两张双面 aid sheet。
detail.en: During the December exam period (date set by the Office of the Registrar). 3 hours, all material, two double-sided aid sheets.

title.zh: 一个数值变量：形状、中心、离散
两个数值变量：散点图、相关、回归
统计学、数据与统计思维

oneLiner.zh: 统计学就是研究数据的科学：先弄清研究的是谁（总体和样本）、测了什么（变量和它的类型）、数据是怎么来的（实验、观察、抽样），再判断结果能不能信（有没有偏差）。
oneLiner.en: Statistics is the science of data: know who is studied (population and sample), what is measured (variables and their types), how the data were collected (experiment, observation, sampling), and whether the result can be trusted (bias).

title.en: Describing Categorical Data; Relationship Among Categorical Variables
title.zh: 描述分类数据；分类变量之间的关系

oneLiner.zh: 一个分类变量用频数、比例、百分比和条形图／饼图来描述；两个分类变量放进列联表，比较条件百分比判断有没有关联，再用比例之差（百分点）和比例之比（几倍、高／低百分之几）比较两组，最后小心辛普森悖论。
oneLiner.en: Describe one categorical variable with counts, proportions, percentages, bar charts and pie charts; put two categorical variables in a contingency table, compare conditional percentages to judge association, compare two groups with the difference and the ratio of proportions, and watch out for Simpson's paradox.

oneLiner.zh: 一个数值变量怎么描述：先画直方图看形状，再用均值、中位数、众数说中心，用极差、方差和标准差说离散；钟形数据还能用经验法则。
oneLiner.en: To describe one quantitative variable, draw a histogram for its shape, use the mean, median and mode for its centre, use the range, variance and standard deviation for its spread, and use the Empirical Rule when the data are bell-shaped.

oneLiner.zh: 用“位置”来描述数据：百分位数、四分位数、IQR、箱线图和离群值栅栏，再用 z 分数看一个数离平均数有几个标准差。
oneLiner.en: Describe data by position: percentiles, quartiles, the IQR, boxplots with outlier fences, and z-scores that count how many standard deviations a value is from the mean.

title.en: Describing Quantitative Data (Part III): Scatterplots, Correlation and Linear Regression
title.zh: 描述数值数据（三）：散点图、相关与线性回归

oneLiner.zh: 把两个数值变量放在一起看：先画散点图看方向、形态、强度，再用相关系数 r 给直线关系打分，最后用回归直线做预测，并解释斜率、截距、残差和 R²。
oneLiner.en: Two quantitative variables together: picture them with a scatterplot, measure the straight-line association with r, then use a regression line to predict and to interpret the slope, intercept, residuals and R².
